claim_hierarchy.claim: Near-complete aggregate and path recovery did not restore the pre-disturbance spatial composition in the focal Ross natural experiment.
claim_hierarchy.boundary: Path-versus-state audit is post-result; no individual identity is inferred.

claim_hierarchy.claim: All three complete Ross down-up episodes had high inverse-path fidelity but weak or negative state restoration.
claim_hierarchy.boundary: The three episodes are not independent replicates.

claim_hierarchy.claim: Persistent decline at Palmer and Signy reweighted breeding structure beyond proportional thinning.
claim_hierarchy.boundary: Unequal attrition is identified at the census level; specific vital-rate mechanisms are not.

claim_hierarchy.claim: Beaufort growth after nesting-capacity release reweighted within-island structure beyond proportional expansion while independent inter-island export declined.
claim_hierarchy.boundary: Within-island census and movement evidence are independent streams, not mediation.

claim_hierarchy.claim: Structured deviations from proportional local recovery can reorganize spatial state even when aggregate recovery and local path reversal are high.
claim_hierarchy.boundary: Trajectory-versus-state distinctions are prior art; the contribution is the empirical population-level natural experiment and process contrasts.

withdrawn_claims: Ross restored or re-expressed the pre-shock spatial state
high inverse-path fidelity is evidence of state restoration
the focal Ross result demonstrates latent spatial memory
the 9.41% inverse-path mismatch is biologically minor because it is numerically small
main_sentence: The population recovered where it had declined, but not in the same proportions.
